svg.title: The full stack, from agents down to infrastructure
svg.desc: Eight layers of the stack, agents on top and infrastructure at the bottom, each with an animation covering its whole surface. 01 Agents & harness: MCP · A2A · LangGraph · CrewAI · Strands · Agno · SDKs; multi-agent runtime, tools, skills, approvals. 02 Interfaces: React · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind · SwiftUI · Streamlit; web and iOS front ends for agent features. 03 Services & APIs: Go · Python · FastAPI · Flask · REST · gRPC · OpenAPI; the services behind every agent and feature. 04 Memory, data & retrieval: Mem0 · Graphiti · pgvector · FAISS · Postgres · Teradata; persistent memory, knowledge graphs, hybrid search. 05 Evals & observability: Opik · OpenTelemetry · LangSmith · LLM judge · trajectory; traces, solve rate, cost and regression gates. 06 Models & training: PyTorch · TensorFlow · Hugging Face · LLaMA · QLoRA; LLMs, fine-tuning, forecasting and risk models. 07 Serving & MLOps: KServe · NVIDIA NIM · MLflow · ONNX · Helm · CI/CD; KServe engine, quantized open LLMs, model routing. 08 Cloud & infrastructure: Kubernetes · EKS · AKS · GKE · AWS · GCP · Azure · on-prem; multi-cloud and on-prem, tenant-isolated.
